allowedInputs: public Ed25519 verification keys embedded in that artifact
RFC 8949, RFC 9052, RFC 9162, RFC 9597, RFC 9942, RFC 9943, and the IANA COSE registry
forbiddenInputs: Node or Python trial verdicts and aggregate summaries
precomputed decoded CBOR trees or reconstructed roots
any private operational key or live transparency service
requiredIndependentOperations: Parse the complete deterministic-CBOR subset and reject trailing bytes, indefinite lengths, duplicate map keys, unsupported simple values, and tags other than 18.
Require COSE_Sign1 tag 18 and the exact four-element array shape.
Decode protected headers from their byte string and require alg=-8, kid, CWT Claims label 15 with issuer 1 and subject 2, and receipt vds=1.
Re-encode Sig_structure independently with context Signature1, protected bytes, empty external_aad, and the attached or supplied detached payload.
Verify Ed25519 statement and receipt signatures from the supplied public keys.
Decode inclusion proof label -1 and reconstruct the RFC9162_SHA256 root from the candidate entry before receipt signature verification.
Decode consistency proof label -2 and verify both retained roots and sizes according to RFC 9162 before returning success.
Verify that a Transparent Statement may attach multiple receipt byte strings under unprotected label 394 without changing the issuer signature.
Run every frozen negative control and reject any joint signature-plus-proof success.
stopConditions: Any vector cannot be parsed under the frozen subset.
Any mandatory protected claim is missing or accepted from an unprotected header.
Any positive signature or proof fails.
The verifier needs a generator-owned decoded value or verdict to decide.
